def simple_exponential_notation(x):
    import re
    match = re.match(r'(\d+)\.(\d+)', x)
    if match:
        int_part = match.group(1)
        dec_part = match.group(2)
        if int_part == '1':
            return f"{dec_part}E{len(dec_part)}"
        else:
            return f"{int_part}.{dec_part}E{len(dec_part)}"
    else:
        raise ValueError("Invalid input format")
